# Fields

Typed key-value fields that a record carries.

<h2 id="value"><code>Value</code></h2>

```rux
pub variant Value {
    Text(char8[..]),
    Integer(int64),
    Unsigned(uint64),
    Float(float64),
    Boolean(bool)
}
```

The value of a field. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Field.rux#L5)

**Cases**

| Name               | Description                                                                       |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Text(char8[..])`  | Text, borrowed from the caller for as long as the record is being written.        |
| `Integer(int64)`   | A signed integer.                                                                 |
| `Unsigned(uint64)` | An unsigned integer.                                                              |
| `Float(float64)`   | A floating-point number. JSON records write a value that is not finite as `null`. |
| `Boolean(bool)`    | A truth value.                                                                    |

<h2 id="field"><code>Field</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Field {
    pub key: char8[..];
    pub value: Value;
}
```

A named value of a record. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Field.rux#L20)

**Fields**

| Name    | Type        | Description                                                                           |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`   | `char8[..]` | The name, which should be a plain identifier so that every format writes it unquoted. |
| `value` | `Value`     | The value.                                                                            |

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="text"><code>Text</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Text(key: char8[..], value: char8[..]) -> Field
```

A field of text.

| Name    | Type        | Description                                    |
| ------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `key`   | `char8[..]` | the name                                       |
| `value` | `char8[..]` | the text, borrowed until the record is written |

**Returns**: the field

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Field.rux#L33)
